name: tjs-platform-functions

scripts.build:transpile: cd .. && for f in functions/src/*.tjs; do bun src/cli/tjs.ts emit "$f" > "${f%.tjs}.js" || { echo "transpile FAILED: $f" >&2; rm -f "${f%.tjs}.js"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.build: npm run build:version && npm run build:transpile && npm run build:bundle
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.build:version: node -e "const v=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/tjs-lang/package.json','utf8')).version;require('fs').writeFileSync('src/version.js','// GENERATED by build:version — the tjs-lang this bundle was built against.\\n'+'export const TJS_LANG_VERSION = '+JSON.stringify(v)+'\\n')"

comment:overrides: Transitive advisories in the DEPLOYED tree, pinned past their affected ranges.
These are runtime-scope, unlike the root tree's dev/deploy-only exemptions:
this code answers requests, so `not shipped to consumers` is not a mitigation.
qs      GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx (array-limit bypass) + GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g (isBuffer
DoS). Reached via firebase-functions > express > qs, i.e. it parses OUR
query strings. express wants ^6.14.0 and body-parser ^6.15.2, so 6.16.0
satisfies both declared ranges — a pin forward, not a fork.
uuid    GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6). Reached via
firebase-admin > @google-cloud/storage > gaxios > uuid. The advisory has
so only the first applies and the lowest safe version is 11.1.1.
@fastify/busboy  GHSA-xjh9-v7x6-24jw (oversized multipart boundary) + GHSA-x8mw-p69m-v3mx
(prototype-named part header), both DoS, both <3.2.1 (published 2026-10-03).
Reached via firebase-admin > @fastify/busboy; 3.2.1 is a patch within its range.
Drop an entry once the parent ships a bump that already satisfies it — an override
that is no longer doing anything is a pin nobody is checking.
proxy-addr GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h (critical, <2.0.8): IP spoofing via an IPv4-mapped
IPv6 trust subnet. firebase-functions > express > proxy-addr decides which
client IP express REPORTS, so it is on the request path. 2.0.8 (2026-09-15)
is inside express's ~2.0.7.
